parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the trashcan is made of HDPE plastic, typically rectangular and hinged to the main body.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the trashcan to contain odors and prevent debris from escaping. It can be lifted or flipped open for waste disposal.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge or pivot point to open and close.

parts.name: Wheel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A rubber wheel attached to the lower rear side of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the trashcan to be rolled for easy transportation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable rolling motion.

parts.name: Wheel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A rubber wheel attached to the opposite side of the trashcan base.
parts.Functional_description: It works in tandem with the left wheel to provide balance and mobility.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable rolling motion.

parts.name: Outlier (Axle Rod)
parts.Basic_description: A steel rod connecting the two wheels at the base of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the axle, providing structural support and enabling wheel rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the wheels rotate around it.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main container body of the trashcan, made of durable HDPE plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and contains waste materials, providing the main storage volume.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary except when the entire trashcan is moved.
